text: Veridian Holdings runs Retail, Logistics, and Financial Services on five disconnected systems -- and nobody can say who owns the customer data living inside any of them.

Oracle Financials counts 438,000 active customers on a billing basis. Salesforce counts 561,000 on an engagement basis. Snowflake's own blended number says 497,000 -- and nobody can explain how it was built.
What actually got this funded wasn't the number mismatch. It was Compliance asking a simple audit question nobody could answer: everywhere a customer's SSN lives, and who can access it.
Five systems, three conflicting numbers, and when we ask who's formally accountable for any single one of them, the honest answer, every time, is nobody.
Three gaps named out loud: no agreed definition, no classified sensitive data, no documented owner. Next: turning this into one written, testable governance requirement for each.
